contradictions: The May 16, 2023 press release (sources 2 and 5) announces intent to delist and redeem the 8.25%/8.00% Senior Notes (TANNI, TANNL, TANNZ), a different security class from TA common stock; this does not pertain to or contradict the common stock delisting evidenced in source-6.
summary: TravelCenters of America Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: TA) was acquired by BP Products North America Inc. via merger completed May 15, 2023. Per the company's Form 8-K, shares of Company Stock ceased trading on Nasdaq prior to market open on May 15, 2023, became eligible for delisting, and were cancelled and converted into the right to receive $86.00 cash merger consideration; the Company requested Nasdaq file a Form 25 to delist the stock. This is distinct from the separate, later notice regarding delisting/redemption of TA's senior notes (TANNI, TANNL, TANNZ), which is a different security class and not evidence about the common stock.
